def: to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt)
kjv: accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform

occurrences.text: But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another: for verily I say unto you, Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.
And it came to pass, when Jesus had made an end of commanding his twelve disciples, he departed thence to teach and to preach in their cities.
And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
And when they were come to Capernaum, they that received tribute money came to Peter, and said, Doth not your master pay tribute?
And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these sayings, he departed from Galilee, and came into the coasts of Judea beyond Jordan;
And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, he said unto his disciples,
And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth.
For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end.
After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, saith, I thirst.
When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the ghost.
And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God’s ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:
But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he shall begin to sound, the mystery of God should be finished, as he hath declared to his servants the prophets.
And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that ascendeth out of the bottomless pit shall make war against them, and shall overcome them, and kill them.
And I saw another sign in heaven, great and marvellous, seven angels having the seven last plagues; for in them is filled up the wrath of God.

And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.
But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.
And when the thousand years are expired, Satan shall be loosed out of his prison,
